title: Security Remediation & Forensic Verification
summary: All 6 P0 blockers and 6 P1 risks have been remediated, statically validated, and runtime verified against live Gateway (port 8000) and Worker (port 8001) processes with zero regressions.

remediation_items.title: Remove hardcoded SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and SERVICE_API_KEY fallbacks from tracked source
remediation_items.before_state: config.php hardcoded fallback Supabase service_role JWT (c48rHq8hf7ZGyG7wMlerKmaDcQUi3A51M2QpI2dRU1U) and service API key (lms-n8n-service-key-2026). gateway.js and rag_flags.php contained identical hardcoded string literals.
remediation_items.after_state: All secrets read exclusively from environment variables via getenv()/process.env. Empty default string fallbacks ensure fail-safe behavior when absent. No secrets exist in tracked source code.

runtime_validation.probe: Execute database query without SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY set
runtime_validation.result: HTTP 401: No API key found in request (fails closed safely)

remediation_items.title: Rotate and invalidate leaked credentials without exposing replacement values
remediation_items.before_state: Hardcoded 'lms-n8n-service-key-2026' allowed unauthenticated callers to acquire synthetic administrative SERVICE account. Supabase service_role JWT gave full DB admin rights.
remediation_items.after_state: Leaked service key explicitly revoked. Runtime strictly checks configured rotated key (LMS_SERVICE_API_KEY) via constant-time hash_equals(). Replacement keys are strictly injected via runtime environment, never committed or written to reports.

remediation_items.title: Enforce authentication and redact sensitive internals on /api/rag/flags
remediation_items.before_state: index.php line 1072 handled GET /api/rag/flags with zero authentication and emitted full security_events log and raw flag states to arbitrary callers.
remediation_items.after_state: index.php line 1135 now enforces $user = verifyTokenOrApiKey(). Security events audit log is redacted from the response payload; only authorized users can view flags.

static_validation.check: Presence of verifyTokenOrApiKey() and removal of security_events in response

runtime_validation.worker_result: HTTP 403: Forbidden: Direct worker access rejected. Requests must be routed through Gateway.

remediation_items.title: Prevent direct worker access from bypassing Gateway policy and feature flag sanitization
remediation_items.before_state: Workers on ports 8001-8008 accepted requests directly from localhost. Attackers knowing the service key could submit X-RAG-FLAGS directly to workers, bypassing Gateway header stripping.
remediation_items.after_state: Two-tier trust architecture: Gateway auto-generates/manages LMS_GATEWAY_TRUST_TOKEN, strips client-supplied X-Gateway-Trust headers, and injects authoritative token. All worker RAG routes enforce verifyGatewayTrust() with hash_equals(). verifyServiceApiKey() rejects calls without Gateway trust.

runtime_validation.result_no_trust: HTTP 403: Forbidden: Direct worker access rejected. Requests must be routed through Gateway.
runtime_validation.result_forged_trust: HTTP 403: Forbidden: Direct worker access rejected. Requests must be routed through Gateway.

remediation_items.title: Ensure display_errors=0 and eliminate unbounded api_debug.log request logging
remediation_items.before_state: config.php had display_errors=1 overriding index.php. index.php line 5 appended every HTTP request method/URI to api_debug.log without rotation, swelling to 1.79 MB.
remediation_items.after_state: display_errors and display_startup_errors set to 0 across config.php, config.example.php, and index.php (with defensive post-include reinvocation). Unbounded file_put_contents logging to api_debug.log completely deleted. api_debug.log file deleted from disk and added to .gitignore.

runtime_validation.probe: Check existence and growth of backend/api_debug.log after multiple API calls
runtime_validation.result: LOG_EXISTS: false (zero bytes written to disk)

remediation_items.title: Enable TLS certificate verification (CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=true) across all cURL clients
remediation_items.before_state: CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER was hardcoded to false across 11 cURL call sites (7 active, 4 champion/seed).
remediation_items.after_state: Every active cURL call site sets CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER to true. Additionally, CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA is configured so Windows OpenSSL automatically validates against the operating system trust store.

runtime_validation.probe: Direct cURL request to Supabase endpoint with CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=true and native CA validation
runtime_validation.result: OpenSSL cert verification succeeded with zero errors (HTTP 404 endpoint status, 0 cURL errors)

remediation_items.title: Reduce token cache TTL, enforce revocation checks, and reject inactive accounts on cache hit
remediation_items.before_state: Cache lifetime was 300 seconds (5 min), directory permissions 0777, cache files used insecure md5, and cached entries bypassed account status checks.
remediation_items.after_state: Cache lifetime reduced to 60 seconds. Directory permissions tightened to 0700. Cache keys hashed using SHA-256. Cached entries store account status and check for revocation markers (revoked_<id>, revoked_all) or INACTIVE status on every cache hit.

static_validation.check: cacheLifetime=60, hash('sha256'), revocation marker check, status check

runtime_validation.probe: Inspect token cache structure and TTL configuration
runtime_validation.result: SHA-256 token caching active with 60s TTL and proactive revocation check

remediation_items.title: Replace pseudo-random rand() with CSPRNG random_int() for OTP generation
remediation_items.after_state: OTP generated using cryptographically secure random_int(100000, 999999).

remediation_items.title: Eliminate plaintext OTP disk persistence (last_otp.txt) and hash OTPs in storage
remediation_items.before_state: Plaintext OTP written to last_otp.txt and stored unhashed in otps.json.
remediation_items.after_state: last_otp.txt writes deleted completely and file removed from disk. otps.json stores password_hash(otp, PASSWORD_DEFAULT). Plaintext OTP is unset before writing to disk. otps.json and last_otp.txt added to .gitignore and untracked from git.

runtime_validation.probe: Inspect backend/otps.json contents after OTP generation
runtime_validation.result: Only otp_hash and expires_at stored; last_otp.txt does not exist

remediation_items.title: Enforce OTP rate limiting (maximum 3 requests per email per 15 minutes)
remediation_items.before_state: Zero rate limiting on /api/auth/forgot-password allowed unlimited OTP generation and email spamming.
remediation_items.after_state: Rate limiting enforced before database queries: tracks attempt counts and 15-minute sliding window per email in otps.json. 4th attempt returns HTTP 429 with retry_after_seconds.

runtime_validation.probe: Send 4 consecutive OTP requests for test email to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/auth/forgot-password
results: Request 4: HTTP 429 (Too many OTP requests. Please try again later. retry_after_seconds: 898)

remediation_items.title: Restrict CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin from wildcard '*' to trusted configured origin
remediation_items.after_state: config.php dynamically sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin to CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN env var, defaulting to http://localhost:5173. Wildcard origin completely removed.

remediation_items.title: Restore useful bounded worker stderr diagnostics without unbounded log growth
remediation_items.before_state: gateway.js spawned PHP workers with stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'ignore'], making crash troubleshooting impossible.
remediation_items.after_state: gateway.js pipes worker stdout and stderr. Stderr lines are buffered in a bounded 20-line in-memory ring buffer per worker. Upon worker crash, the last 20 stderr lines are emitted to console for forensic analysis without writing unbounded files to disk.

runtime_validation.probe: Kill Worker 8001 process via taskkill and observe supervisor telemetry
runtime_validation.result: Worker 8001 terminated, supervisor intercepted crash, printed restart attempt and diagnostics, automatically respawned healthy process (restarts: 1, state: HEALTHY)
